purpose: Second reusable legal domain proving that the Ireland Housing Data engine can move beyond residential rent.
source_hierarchy: Land and Conveyancing Law Reform Act 2009
Land and Conveyancing Law Reform Act 2021 where applicable
Land Registration Rules 2021 and other applicable current rules
Tailte Éireann official guidance and Land Registry services
core_questions: What rights or burdens appear on the register?
What does the registry map establish and what does it not establish?
Are there mortgages, judgment mortgages, cautions or inhibitions?
Is an easement or right of way registered?
What further title documents must be examined?
guardrails: A folio is evidence of registered title but does not answer every property-law question.
Registry map boundaries are not automatically conclusive of the physical boundary.
Ownership does not mean absence of planning, building, environmental, tax or other statutory constraints.
A public register record is not automatically permission to republish personal data without privacy analysis.
Do not infer unregistered rights solely from absence on a folio.
